caption: The drawing depicts a single bottle with a rounded, flattened body and a short, narrow neck. The bottle is predominantly rendered in shades of green, with some blue and purple highlights and shadows suggesting a glazed ceramic or glass material. The surface of the bottle features a raised, oval medallion that contains an ornate depiction of a basket filled with an arrangement of flowers and fruit. The basket is detailed with vertical grooves and scroll-like handles, and the fruit and flowers are shown as rounded and elliptical shapes, with some leaves extending outwards. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background with no additional objects or decorations. Near the lower right of the bottle, there is a small, red signature block containing the artist’s name, "Hal Blakeley."
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
